events.text: Leland Stanford's Palo Alto Stock Farm begins (it runs until 1903)
March 13: Leland Stanford Jr. dies of typhoid in Florence, age 15
November 11: Leland and Jane Stanford sign the Founding Grant
October 1: Opening Day. More than 500 students and 15 faculty; David Starr Jordan is president
June 21: Leland Stanford dies, plunging the university into financial crisis
February 28: Jane Stanford dies in Honolulu
April 18, 5:12 AM: The great earthquake (magnitude 7.7–7.9) strikes; the arch, spire and new library fall
Herbert Hoover, Pioneer Class, hears he has won the U.S. presidency at his Stanford home
The Loma Prieta earthquake strikes; Memorial Church, Green Library and the museum need years of repair
Google, born in the Gates building, moves off campus and incorporates

source.title: NSF: On the Origins of Google
